facts.value: Sustainable development has become crucial as the world faces environmental, social, and economic challenges.
facts.programme_association: Online Master of Science in Engineering in Sustainable Engineering

facts.value: Defined by the Brundtland Report (1987), it ensures present needs are met without compromising future generations' ability to meet theirs.
facts.programme_association: Online Master of Science in Engineering in Sustainable Engineering

facts.value: It is based on three pillars: economic sustainability (equitable growth), environmental sustainability (resource preservation), and social sustainability (justice and inclusivity).
facts.programme_association: Online Master of Science in Engineering in Sustainable Engineering

facts.value: Milestones like the Stockholm Conference (1972) and the Rio Earth Summit (1992) shaped global sustainability efforts, including the SDGs.
facts.programme_association: Online Master of Science in Engineering in Sustainable Engineering

facts.value: Challenges include war, poverty, and environmental degradation.
facts.programme_association: Online Master of Science in Engineering in Sustainable Engineering

facts.value: India's initiatives, such as Swachh Bharat and Jal Jeevan Mission, support these global efforts for inclusive, sustainable growth.
